transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, November 5. transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Delhi. Can't breathe. can't move; AQI inches closer to severe. Delhi's air quality index is deteriorating and expected to reach severe levels by Friday. Local emissions contribute 31 percent while stubble burning has increased to 16.2 percent of total pollution. Various areas in Delhi are already experiencing severe air quality conditions. The Commission for Air Quality Management issued notices over stubble burning in Punjab districts. 3 Naga militants killed in Manipur factional gunfight. Three militants lost their lives in a clash between Zeliangrong groups in Manipur's Noney district. The conflict arose after accusations were made regarding one group's collaboration with security forces. Additionally, there was gunfire directed at passenger vehicles in Ukhrul, though no injuries occurred. The Manipur government has initiated measures to restore peace through the establishment of local peace committees. Watch: Hot oil spills on 3 as woman rams SUV into kebab centre in Bengaluru. On October 28, Sajina Begum accidentally drove her SUV into Halevuru kebab centre, injuring three men. The incident occurred when she felt dizzy and mistakenly pressed the accelerator instead of the brakes. Paramesh A filed a complaint after she failed to fulfill her promise to cover repair costs and medical expenses. While Safrulla Abdul Aziz claimed to have already paid approximately rupees 75,000 for the injuries, the matter remains unclear. US Midterms: Elon Musk, 3 other tech billionaires among Trump's biggest backers. In a remarkable turn of events, Elon Musk has become the top contributor, donating an astounding $474 million to various Republican candidates. Similarly, Larry Ellison backed Trump's 2024 campaign with a notable but undisclosed $45 million. Additionally, Michael Dell made headlines by pledging $6.25 billion to establish 'Trump Accounts' for disadvantaged youth. Meet 3 Pune schoolchildren selected for Sarabhai Younglings Internship. Pune's very own Yaqub Bangi, Yassira Memon, and Shubham Pariyar have earned coveted spots in the Sarabhai Younglings Internship program by triumphing in the national SPOT science aptitude test by the Vikram Sarabhai Science Foundation. This enriching program will provide them with invaluable insights through institutions like ISRO, HAL, and IIM Bangalore. Their journey is supported by Panaah Communities, emphasizing how access to opportunities can nurture potential in underserved areas. Midterm results: Trump may have lost Congress, but he still has an ace up his sleeve. The Democrats' sweeping victory in the US midterm elections has dramatically reshaped the balance of power in Washington, handing the party sizeable majorities in both chambers of Congress and setting the stage for a confrontation with President Donald Trump. After seismic shift in US, a new Congress but an old consensus. The shift in US Congressional control is a pivotal moment for Washington, but its impact on the India–US strategic partnership will likely be more subtle than disruptive. Utah girl missing for 17 months rescued from Oregon home; man charged. A 17-year-old girl missing from Utah was located in Oregon after investigators received a tip about her. The girl had communicated with another minor online, revealing she was being held against her will. The FBI monitored a video call during which she identified the man who had picked her up. Adam Hunter Harmel, 39, was arrested and charged with transporting a minor for illegal sexual activities. Australian mining heiress pledges $120 million to 10 environmental groups. In a groundbreaking move, an Australian mining heiress and her spouse have gifted A$120 million to ten environmental organizations nationwide, marking one of the most significant private donations for conservation in Australian history. Among the beneficiaries, Greenpeace Australia Pacific will receive A$25 million, enabling it to enhance campaigns and engage in lengthy legal battles. This funding represents a transformative approach to how mining revenue supports environmental efforts. How Florida turned toy rabbits into robots to lure pythons and protect Everglades. Florida researchers created robotic rabbits to attract invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. These decoys imitate real prey by moving and generating heat, aiding in detection. The project employs remote monitoring to facilitate python removal by the South Florida Water Management District. Traditional methods relied on live rabbits, which posed logistics challenges, making robotic alternatives more practical. After JD Vance, now Trump Jr blames Iran war for US midterms defeat. SBI Pension Funds MD and CEO Pranay Ranjan Dwivedi explains the potential returns, suggested allocation and risks. The development has triggered concern among bullion dealers, jewellery manufacturers and traders, particularly because the adulterated gold can appear similar to genuine gold during initial inspection. Robotic surgery is increasingly covered by health insurance in India, but not without complications. Despite having a high sum insured, policyholders must navigate sub-limits and exclusions that can significantly reduce payouts. Understanding these nuances before undergoing surgery is crucial to avoid unexpected out-of-pocket expenses when the final bill arrives. Gold and silver prices today: Bought on Dhanteras 2025? transcript.title: Science and technology
transcript.text: Next, science and technology. What is Hangang? South Korea unveils a $276 million supercomputer with 614.7 petaflops of computing power. South Korea has launched Hangang, a $276 million national supercomputer equipped with 8,496 Nvidia GPUs and 614.7 petaflops of computing power. Designed to accelerate AI and scientific research, the system is expected to rank among the world's top 10 supercomputers. X says its updated web app is way faster. X is introducing a new version of its web app that it says is much faster than before, and it's now rolling out the updated app "one country at a time" for signed-in users. "Open a profile on X.com over a slow connection," principal engineer Yagiz Nizipli said in a blog post about the changes. Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage. The company is said to be significantly dropping the amount it's spending on AI for its engineering teams. SLAC scientists find conclusive proof of a mysterious third type of magnetism. For nearly 90 years, scientists believed magnetism fell into just two categories, but researchers have now confirmed a remarkable third type called altermagnetism. Using specialized X-rays, they uncovered a unique magnetic signature that proves these materials behave differently from conventional magnets. Altermagnets combine stability with the ability to efficiently carry information, potentially overcoming major limitations in today's electronics. The discovery could lead to faster computers, more efficient data centers, and breakthroughs in quantum technology. Sony PS5 trade-in offer: US gamers can get up to $400 for old consoles ahead of GTA 6 launch; check details. Sony is offering US gamers up to $400 in cash for trading in their old PlayStation 5 consoles through a partnership with refurbished electronics marketplace Back Market, according to TweakTown. The offer could help players upgrade to the $899.99 PS5 Pro ahead of the much-anticipated GTA 6 launch. Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink. With smartphone sales tanking by around 20 percent compared to 2025, Qualcomm is looking to data centers to help boost its bottom line. During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming. Data center opposition crossed party lines in Tuesday's midterms. NASA is racing against time to save the Hubble Space Telescope. NASA is exploring a daring plan to save the legendary Hubble Space Telescope from its eventual fiery plunge into Earth's atmosphere. After more than 35 years of groundbreaking discoveries, Hubble is slowly losing altitude, and without intervention, it could fall back to Earth as early as 2033 or 2034. To keep the iconic observatory operating, NASA is asking private space companies to propose innovative ways to boost Hubble into a higher orbit, upgrade its capabilities, or safely dispose of it when its mission finally ends. 17 better ways Elon Musk could have wasted $446 million. One of the basic problems of spending too much time on social media is that you are cooking your brain by reading posts from a pack of attention-seeking lunatics. If your social media of choice is the site formerly known as Twitter, and it is your main source of contact with the outside world, you AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress , here's how they fared. AI industry PACs spent millions influencing the 2026 midterms, with mixed results. Political groups are already looking toward the next election cycle. MIT scientists break a 20-year rule and unlock never-before-seen crystal structures. MIT scientists have challenged two decades of conventional thinking by discovering that flexible molecular connections, rather than rigid ones, can unlock entirely new ways to arrange nanoparticles. The breakthrough could lead to a new generation of designer materials with unusual properties and applications in electronics, medicine, and energy. AI moves beyond recommendations to reshape entire shopping experience on e-commerce apps: Report. Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the way e-commerce applications personalise the shopping experience, moving beyond conventional product recommendations to potentially influence the entire interface customers see when they open an app, according to an industry report by AppMaker. How I learned to love an obnoxious phone grip. Much like a great recipe, it started with a stick of butter. This wasn't real butter; it was a friend's new phone grip, complemented by a phone case with bold stripes. Butter is in vogue now, or at least that's what a 12-year-old told me a few months ago. While it's not yet clear what kind of product the smartphone startup is cooking up, Nothing's CEO said the product is designed to leverage AI for productivity gains. A surprising discovery could help aging muscles repair themselves. Scientists have discovered a compound that transforms a natural muscle-repair protein into a more powerful version dubbed "Super HGF," more than doubling its ability to bind to a key receptor while protecting it from age-related chemical damage. The breakthrough, supported by early mouse experiments, could eventually help combat muscle loss and preserve strength as people age. Realme 17T 5G live images reveal redesigned camera module and slimmer bezels ahead of launch. Realme 17T 5G live images have surfaced online, revealing a redesigned rear camera module and slimmer display bezels ahead of its expected launch. The smartphone is expected to succeed the Realme 16T 5G and join the upcoming Realme 17 series as a more affordable offering. Bose's QuietComfort Headphones are more than half off. It's not often that some of the best noise-canceling headphones you can buy are over half off. But right now, the first-gen Bose QuietComfort Headphones are on sale for $169.99 ($190 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, and Bose, matching its best price to date. The newer, second-generation version that launched in August is also down Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says. During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only four people booked a ride using an AI agent. AI helps Stanford scientists discover a "natural Ozempic" with a surprising advantage. Stanford researchers have discovered an AI-identified natural molecule that dramatically suppresses appetite and promotes fat loss in animals, potentially offering an Ozempic-like weight-loss treatment without common digestive side effects or significant muscle loss. Called BRP, the molecule reduced food intake by up to 50 percent and targets a different brain pathway, raising hopes for a more precise obesity treatment if future human trials prove successful. 87 percent of organisations face threat-related incidents, preparedness gaps persist: McKinsey. Around 87 per cent of organisations experienced at least one threat-related incident in the 24 months preceding a survey, but many remain inadequately prepared to deal with risks beyond conventional cybersecurity, according to a report by McKinsey and Company. Gemini for Home now plugs into AT and T's smart security system. AT and T's smart home security system now integrates with Gemini for Home. The company says its Connected Life system is the "first" home security product to integrate with Google Home Premium, enabling a bunch of Gemini-powered features that can summarize home events, search your video history, and more. With the update, Gemini for Home can provide Snapchat surpasses 30M paid subscribers. The milestone comes a year after Snapchat announced a controversial limit on free storage for its Memories feature and informed users it would start requiring users to pay $1.99 per month for additional storage or subscribe to Snapchat+ to retain their Memories. Permanent daylight saving time has a dark side, scientists warn. A new study warns that permanent daylight saving time could force American children to make at least 2 billion additional school commutes in darkness, potentially increasing safety risks and disrupting their biological clocks. Researchers found that fatal crashes involving school-aged pedestrians were roughly twice as likely during dark mornings as after sunrise.

transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. A drug, custom-made in The Hague, for 7 kids in India. TFR down, need relook at popn control laws like 2-child norm for polls: SC. Observing that laws aimed at controlling population growth in the country had lost their significance because of a fall in the total fertility rate (TFR) from 3 to 1.9, below the replacement level of 2.1, Supreme Court Wednesday said the foundation of such laws had "crumbled", they had become "counter-productive" and their validity, which was upheld by it two decades ago, needed to be re-examined in the present situation. Two sisters from Lucknow were among four trekkers found dead following an avalanche on the Kedartal trekking route in Uttarkashi district, with rescue teams recovering two more bodies on Wednesday, taking the toll to four, report Gaurav Talwar and Ashish Mishra. Andhra, Kerala top ease of vehicle ownership index; UP, Bihar at bottom: Report. Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Tamil Nadu have emerged as the top-performing states in ease of vehicle ownership, while Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and West Bengal rank at the bottom, reflecting wide disparities in procedures for transferring ownership of used vehicles. Mahadev betting app co-promoter Ravi Uppal arrested in UAE, India to extradite him. Uppal, 46, was taken into custody by authorities in Dubai on the basis of an Interpol Red Notice issued at the request of Indian investigating agencies, officials told PTI. The CBI and the ED are now coordinating efforts to secure his extradition to India. Investigators have also alleged that Uppal, like Chandrakar, secured a passport from Vanuatu, an island country in the South Pacific. Manipur violence panel gets sixth extension, deadline pushed to May 2027. The Cabinet is learnt to have approved another extension for the Commission of Inquiry into the Manipur violence, giving it another year, until May 20, 2027, to submit its report. UN report finds huge gap in adaptation finance ahead of COP31. Developing nations require approximately $305 billion annually by 2035 for climate change adaptation efforts. Rich countries' collective pledge could only reach $85-120 billion each year by 2035. While current financial contributions are around $28.2-31.7 billion, this is still inadequate. UN Environment Programme emphasizes the urgent need for increased adaptation financing and overcoming institutional barriers. Two scrap collectors die in Srinagar fire, CM Omar Abdullah announces rupees 4L relief. Two scrap collectors, including a minor, were killed in a fire that engulfed around 80 makeshift shelters in Durbal, Bemina, on the outskirts of Srinagar early Wednesday, officials said. Srinagar MP's exit part of BJP's 'Op Lotus' plan in J and K, says NC. Governing National Conference (NC) in Jammu and Kashmir Wednesday described the resignation of its Srinagar MP, Aga Ruhullah Mehdi, as the handiwork of BJP, saying the party had succeeded in its mission under 'Operation Lotus'. 'Normalise, recognise and formalise': Nadda accuses Congress of opposing SIR to legitimise outsiders, destabilise country. Union health minister JP Nadda accused the Congress party of opposing the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists. He alleged that their actions are aimed at protecting outsiders who support their political ambitions. Nadda criticized the Congress for undermining the credibility of the Election Commission when faced with electoral losses. He noted that the current electoral process includes Booth Level Officers facilitating voter registration door-to-door. Trump's 'Freedom In Space' signals new contest for Moon; India's challenge is safeguarding strategic autonomy. As Americans voted in the midterm elections, US President Donald Trump issued a proclamation titled "The American Declaration of Freedom in Space", declaring that the US would lead the exploration, development, use and settlement of space.
